title: Adaptive Guardrail Matrix for Phased Releases
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Define and deliver an adaptive guardrail matrix and operational playbook that governs metric thresholds, escalation paths, and automated mitigations across release phases (alpha, staged beta, progressive ramp, full launch). This ticket captures cross-functional deliverables: metric taxonomy, signal weighting, detection windows, automated circuit-breaker rules, dashboard templates, and an evaluation cadence for A/B experiments and canaries. Goal is to reduce time-to-detect regressions while minimizing false positives and preserving ability to iterate quickly in early phases.
acceptance_criteria: A concise metric taxonomy that maps product signals (latency, errors, quality regressions, cost delta, data-loss) to phase-specific weights and thresholds
A documented escalation ladder with automated actions (rollback, traffic-shift, model-fallback) and human review gates for each phase
Grafana dashboard templates and alerting rules checked into observability repo and validated in staging cluster
Playbook entries for A/B experiment windows and canary sampling (cohort definitions, minimum sample sizes, statistical significance guidance)
Security review completed and KMS/audit logging requirements documented for private deployments
milestones: Canary automation prototype deployed to staging - 2026-03-22
Playbook and runbook published to Confluence - 2026-03-29
